sequence: one browser context per pass at 1440x900, perf instrumentation installed before load

b. build: library Add, click the clip name bar, blur; Control+d x199, each waited until the lane data-clip-count equals press + 1 (scale.harness.build-ms = the Control+d loop); self-check lane count 200, >= 1 mounted clip and one distinct data-clip-start per mounted clip, 0 collapsed groups; wait for quiet

c. default zoom, scroll 0, 1x: scale.dom.page, scale.dom.clip-subtree, scale.clips.model, scale.clips.mounted, scale.clips.in-window (in-window = clips intersecting the lane area: the timeline scroller box minus the first track header width); self-check visible gap here, at f, at g and after each h step: the mounted clips cover the lane area up to the model end with no hole, which assumes the back-to-back Control+d build of step b (equal-length clips, each starting where the previous one ends)
d. zoom keys at 1x: 5 x "-" then 5 x "=", one window per key until quiet (scale.zoom.*); self-check direction per key and return to the start value
e. the same keys at 6x CPU (Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate), ids with .6x; rate back to 1
f. minimum zoom: "-" until the Zoom slider value equals its min (at most 60 keys), wait for quiet (scale.*.min-zoom)
g. minimum zoom, timeline scroller scrollLeft = round((scrollWidth - clientWidth) / 2), wait for quiet (scale.*.min-zoom-mid); self-check scrollLeft > 0 and in-window >= 1
h. scroll page crossings: scrollLeft += clientWidth x4, one window per step until quiet (scale.scroll.*)

i. zoom keys at minimum zoom, scroll as left by h: 5 x "=" then 5 x "-", one window per key until quiet (scale.zoom.min.*), at 1x, then scrollLeft restored to its value at the start of i, then the same keys at 6x (ids with .6x); self-check direction per key, return to the minimum and the restored scrollLeft

Ceiling (PERF-14b-ii, TL-R398-SK-L3): <= 140 against the virtualized lane's 116.5 (min = max over 3 passes, b-round-401/perf-sketch-scale-run1.json and run2.json). This is a known, accepted cost and not a target: HEAD without virtualization measures 57.75, and a page crossing mounts the next page's clips once, so the per-step work roughly doubles while the page DOM is 4.5x smaller. Hysteresis is the later candidate PERF-CAND-14-SCROLL-HYSTERESIS.
